result.rationale: Mild wrist soreness without injury, numbness, or weakness is self-limited, but the patient is asking about ibuprofen at 24 weeks pregnant. NSAIDs are generally avoided in pregnancy (especially from 20 weeks onward due to fetal kidney/amniotic fluid risks), so a clinician should advise on safe alternatives (e.g., acetaminophen, rest, wrist splinting). No red flags requiring urgent escalation.
